Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax relief for certain limited purpose public corporations, commissions, and authorities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax relief for certain limited purposepublic corporations, commissions, and authorities; adding a new sectionto chapter 82.04 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to public corporations, commissions, orauthorities created under RCW 35.21.660 or 35.21.730 for amountsderived from sales of tangible personal property and services to: (1) A limited liability company in which the corporation,commission, or authority is the managing member; (2) A limited partnership in which the corporation, commission, orauthority is the general partner; or (3) A single asset entity required under any federal, state, orlocal governmental housing assistance program, which is controlleddirectly or indirectly by the corporation, commission, or authority.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax imposed by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales oftangible personal property and services provided by a publiccorporation, commission, or authority created under RCW 35.21.660 or35.21.730 to an eligible entity. (2) For purposes of this section, "eligible entity" means a limitedliability company, a limited partnership, or a single asset entity,described in section 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse of tangible personal property and services provided by a publiccorporation, commission, or authority created under RCW 35.21.660 or35.21.730 to an eligible entity. (2) For purposes of this section, "eligible entity" means a limitedliability company, a limited partnership, or a single asset entity,described in section 1 of this act.
